planned_by: Claude (Critic): owner asked to see evolution intuitively on the web
goal:
T28 — make the measured evolution visible: an intuitive, beautiful timeline on the Performance page.

Data source: GET /v1/performance -> history: MeasurementRecord[] (lib/api.ts), each with kind (X_SINGLE|PIPELINE),
suite_version, model, harness_version, n, passed, pass_rate, wilson95 [lo, hi], cost_cents, created_at, per_family
{family: {n, passed}}, evidence_id. Never invent, round away or recompute these numbers.

1. NEW apps/web/lib/evolutionTimeline.ts — pure, dependency-free (no imports except `import type`), exported
   `buildTimeline(history)` returning
   { segments: [ { suite_version, model,
                   points: [{measurement_id, kind, suite_version, harness_version, created_at, pass_rate, lo, hi,
                             passed, n, cost_cents, evidence_id}],          // sorted by created_at
                   harnessChanges: [{index, from, to}],  // index into points where harness_version differs from the
                                                         // previous point of the segment
                   families: [{family, cells: [{measurement_id, passed, n}]}]  // one cell per point, in point
                                                         // order; a family missing from a record -> n: 0, passed: 0
               } ] }
   Segments: consecutive-in-time groups by (suite_version, model); a suite or model change starts a new segment
   (different suites are not comparable). lo/hi are exactly wilson95[0]/[1]. Empty history -> {segments: []}.
2. NEW apps/web/components/EvolutionTimeline.tsx — inline SVG, no chart library (do not add dependencies):
   - one panel per segment, titled with suite version and model; between panels a clear "not comparable" divider;
   - x: measurements in time order (date label under each), y: pass rate 0-100% with light gridlines at 0/25/50/75/100;
   - each point: a dot at pass_rate plus a vertical Wilson 95% interval bar; X_SINGLE and PIPELINE in two distinct
     colors with a small legend; a thin line joins points of the same kind within a segment;
   - harness changes: a dashed vertical marker labelled with the new harness_version;
   - every point has an accessible <title> (kind, passed/n, percent, interval, harness, date) and links to
     /verify/<evidence_id>;
   - per-family heatmap under each panel: rows = families, columns = points, cell text "passed/n", fill intensity by
     passed/n (empty cells hatched or muted, never shown as 0%);
   - entrance animation (bars/dots grow in, ~400ms) disabled under prefers-reduced-motion (Tailwind motion-reduce or a
     media query);
   - responsive: works at 375px (horizontal scroll inside the chart container only, never the page); uses the existing
     theme tokens/classes so it fits the current dark UI.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/performance/page.tsx: render <EvolutionTimeline> as the first card (heading from messages),
   built with buildTimeline(perf.history). Not-measured state: a short explanation, no fake axes with numbers.
4. messages/ko.json and messages/en.json: all new strings under a "timeline" group, identical key sets.
Do not change API code. Do not edit apps/web/app/performance/page.tsx (non-locale) beyond what tsc requires.
